doc: Advances past a name/string field: runs func_8004E9EC(arg0, arg1) to fill the first 2*arg1 bytes of the buffer, then copies 2 bytes of the D_80080B70 pattern to the position right after (arg0 + 2*arg1) via strncpy, and returns a pointer to that appended position.

globals.name: D_80080B70
globals.decl: typedef struct S_80080B70 { /* 0x0 */ s8 b0; /* 0x1 */ s8 b1; /* 0x2 */ s8 b2; /* 0x3 */ s8 pad[13]; } S_80080B70; /* size 0x10, only bytes 0-2 are read as a 3-byte fill pattern; must be declared >8B total so address-of forces %hi/%lo instead of $gp-relative */ extern S_80080B70 D_80080B70;

calls: func_8004E9EC(u8 *arg0, s32 arg1) -- void return, fills up to 2*arg1 bytes of arg0 using D_80080B70 as a repeating pattern
strncpy(char *dst, const char *src, u32 n) -- standard libc strncpy, resolved via symbol table
